blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY- A woman died from a fall from a building along Kisad Road behind Burnham Park on Sunday, prompting an investigation by the Baguio City Police Office (BCPO). An initial report said the incident occurred shortly after 8 a.m. Police Station 5 later conducted a follow-up investigation and was able to identify the deceased woman, but details have not been made public. BCPO has yet to establish the circumstances surrounding the fall, and the investigation remains ongoing.
